createPost.description: Compose and publish a post on X through the logged-in session: open the composer, type the text, attach media files, click the enabled Post button, and return the published status URL when discoverable.

text.description: Post body. @handles linkify on publish; newlines are fine (Enter does not submit).

media.description: Absolute file paths to attach. One gif OR up to 4 images per post; gifs cannot be mixed with images.

returns.description: {posted: true, url} on success; {posted: false, reason} on refusal (not logged in, no Post button).
